value.chinese_level: HSK 5, 180 or above, each section at least 60

english.quote: 除汉语言专业外,所有专业须达到HSK5级180分以上(单项不低于60分)
english.notes: Chinese-taught: every major except Chinese Language needs HSK 5 >= 180 (each section >= 60). Not an English requirement (IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 70 only for the English major).

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published: selection by material review 'according to high-school grades, language level and overall ability' plus written test and interview for the School of Computer Science; CSCA test required (STEM Chinese, Mathematics, Physics per the 2027 catalogue). Source: https://hwxy.nju.edu.cn/lxnd/zsxx/bkxm/sbzn/index.html

deadline.notes: Application period 1 March - 15 May for international bachelor applicants; the guide is for 2027 entry (it cites the 2027 catalogue and age on 2027-09-01) but the date carries no year. CSCA scores also due 15 May.

value.population: international long-term students, undergraduate, Science, Engineering & Business

tuition.notes: Table 'Long-term Students (RMB/academic year)', columns Humanities & Social Sciences / Science, Engineering & Business / Medicine. The Bachelor's Programs page also lists '¥32,000 per academic year for programs of the Software Institute' - Computer Science & Technology is in the School of Computer Science, so the science rate is taken; confirm with the office.

value.name: Nanjing Municipal Government Scholarship for International Students

scholarship_exists.quote: Nanjing Government Scholarship of International Students was established by Nanjing Municipal Government in 2013
scholarship_exists.notes: Undergraduate: CNY 10,000 one-time reward; applied for via NJU's Institute for International Students; the page still shows the 2024 application window (2024.07.01-2024.07.31). Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) also listed.

scholarship_international.quote: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health and friendly to China.
